newsitem.title: USA: CRIIMI MAE files $272.6 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: CRIIMI MAE files $272.6 million shelf.

text.p: CRIIMI MAE Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday to sell up to $272.6 million in debt securities, preferred and common stock and warrants.
When combined with a previous registration, CRIIMI will have a total offering of $300 million in securities and equities available for sale.

Net proceeds will be used to acquire additional mortgage assets, including subordinated CMBs, to sponsor and/or participate in collateralized mortgage obligation programs, to make other acquisitions relating to the mortgage business.
Proceeds will also be used for other general corporate purposes, including working capital, CRIIMI said in the filing.
CRIIMI, based in Rockville, Md., is a commercial mortgage company structured as a self-administrated real estate investment trust.
